description: Control: purely presentational component — should skip tests

The acceptance tests already cover every status value in context. Based on the prompt instructions about earning the test, decide whether to write tests or skip.

description: Tests for filter state machine should verify toggle/pressed state
task: Write tests for the filter state machine in ChipBar. ChipBar renders chips for each status. Clicking a chip toggles its aria-pressed state. Multiple chips can be pressed simultaneously. An 'All' chip deselects all others when pressed.
